verdict.rationale: First-party docs have a dedicated headless page saying the Antigravity CLI can run non-interactively to script agent tasks, integrate with CI pipelines, and capture machine-readable output. The Python Agent SDK exposes the same agent loop and tools programmatically, and cron-based Scheduled Tasks run agents autonomously in the background. missing for 10: detailed documentation of headless flags, output formats and CI authentication, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
